scripts.test: npm run test:offline && npm run test:integration
scripts.test:offline: node --check server.js && node --check or-patients.js && SESSION_SECRET=test-secret-please-change-me-32chars node --test --test-force-exit test/test_or_patients.js test/test_ai_chat_logic.js test/test_esp32_node_status.js test/test_esp32_revoke.js test/test_esp32_status.js test/test_firmware_ota.js test/test_priority_rest.js test/test_live_status_freshness.js test/test_template_regex_escapes.js test/test_alert_hysteresis.js
scripts.test:integration: sh -c 'ok=1; for f in test_wards_mgmt.js test_monitor_ai_chat.js; do [ -f "$f" ] || { echo "SKIP integration: $f not present (gitignored, live-stack only)"; ok=0; }; done; [ "$ok" = 1 ] && SESSION_SECRET=test-secret-please-change-me-32chars node --test --test-force-exit test_wards_mgmt.js test_monitor_ai_chat.js; if [ -x mqtt-bridge/.venv/bin/python ] && [ -f mqtt-bridge/test_mqtt_bridge.py ]; then cd mqtt-bridge && ./.venv/bin/python -m unittest test_mqtt_bridge; else echo "SKIP integration: mqtt-bridge venv or test_mqtt_bridge.py not present"; fi'
scripts.test:or-patients: node --check server.js && node --check or-patients.js && node --test test/test_or_patients.js
